learning_outcomes.text: Ability to understand fundamentals of moist air
Be able to calculate cooling load (heat gain).
Ability to comprehend air conditioning systems and cycles
Ability to perform designs of air conditioning systems

syllabus_topics: The introduction of air conditioning and thermal comfort.
Processes of heating, cooling and air conditioning.
Cooling load methods, interior and exterior design requirements.
Cooling load calculations with CLTD/SCL/CLF methods.
Cooling load calculations with CLTD/SCL/CLF methods.
Measurement and control of air conditioning systems.
bibliography: Heating Ventilating, And Air Conditioning Face, C. McQuiston, Jerald, D. Parker, Howell, R.H., Sauer, H.J., Coad W.J.: Principles of Heating, Ventilating and Air Conditioning, ASHRAE, 1998.
İklimlendirme Esasları ve Uygulamaları, Recep Yamankaradeniz, İlhami Horuz, Salih Coşkun, Ö. Kaynaklı, N. Yamankaradeniz, Dora Yayıncılık 2008.
